submission.justification: Absorber-F1 at 5 mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution of 3.046% at 100 GeV, which is the primary goal. Through systematic simulation across all three candidate materials and plate thicknesses from 2-10 mm, Absorber-F1 consistently outperformed the alternatives. At its optimal thickness of 5 mm, F1 achieves approximately 19% better resolution than F3 (3.758% at 4.5 mm) and 40% better than F2 (5.07% at 5 mm). The simulation results align with the 2025 preliminary study showing F1's superior performance. All candidate materials are stated to be machinable to required tolerances and compatible with the mechanical support design. The readout and cooling systems are common to all options, making F1 the clear choice for optimal detector performance.

requirements.requirement: Calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
requirements.evidence: No documents explicitly address radiation activation or hands-on maintenance restrictions for any of the three candidate materials. All three materials are presented as viable candidates without safety exclusions.
Recommended plate thickness of 5 mm is within the specified range of 2-10 mm
